client: I've been feeling really overwhelmed by my new job at the marketing agency. It seems like everyone else has so much more experience, and I'm constantly worried I'm not meeting expectations. therapist: It sounds like you're really feeling the weight of this new job and the pressure to meet expectations. It's completely understandable to feel this way, and exploring these feelings in therapy can provide you with strategies to manage the stress and find your footing. You're not alone in this, and together we can work on building your confidence and perspective.
